name: Google personal information removal request

search.notes: Search Google for the name with a city to collect the result URLs that show personal info.

steps: Collect the URL of every result and page that shows the personal info.
Open the removal request form and choose that the content contains personal information.
Pick the type of info, such as contact details or a government ID number.
Enter the name, contact email, the result URLs and the search terms used, and add screenshots if asked.
Submit and watch the email inbox for the decision.
optout.notes: Works in any country and does not need a Google Account. A representative can file for someone else. Google can still keep results it judges to be in the public interest.

verification_note: Form and the help page that links to it loaded on 2026-10-27.
